acceptanceCriteria: A coverage recorder captures executed units for a compiled test run with evidence pins.
Its output is consumed by the CCE usefulness/coverage report; a focused test covers one live run or records NOT_RUN with the command.
body: Residual from lane cce-1022k (PR beamfall/corvint#1546, seal 1aa0691af). There is no recorder that captures which application code a compiled test executes, so V1-1685 runtime coverage cannot be measured beyond what was delivered.
title: CCE has no coverage recorder for compiled tests
